result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: a restaurant name is truncated in the Fastest near you carousel, and the category filter chips appear cut off on the right.

issues.description: The third restaurant name under Fastest near you is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of showing the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow full restaurant names to wrap to a second line, use a smaller font, or ensure card width accommodates typical name lengths without clipping.

issues.description: The category filter row ends with a partially visible empty/light chip after Healthy, suggesting an incomplete or awkwardly clipped control.
issues.suggestion: Ensure category chips scroll cleanly or that only intentional partial peeks of the next labeled chip are shown.
